entry_points.text: Reclamation enters by draining a page parent set and by bounded collection plus invalidation of stale descendants of a non-leaf parent.

Userspace control enforces count limits, duplicates arrays with error reporting, transfers ownership to shared installer, refreshes dynamic state before query and copies out with actual count; guest emulation is an additional entry.
Operations record a VCPU request, conditionally invalidate cached fault state, inject emulated debug via userspace exit or queued vector, and create per-VCPU debug files.

exports.text: Roots drop one reference with deferred reclaim on final invalid release; predicate reports when clearing needs atomic handling; accessor reports effective maximum paging level.
Performance model rebuilds neutral limits, delegates to vendor logic and publishes availability; helpers account retired instructions and recalculate software emulation markers.
CPUID lookup prefers exact match with optional redirect to maximum basic leaf plus runtime fixes and tracing; guest emulation checks permission and advances; device query enumerates supported leaves.
Three VCPU ops handle legacy set, extended set and query with count bounds; one-time global init builds per-leaf supportable features with helpers adjusting bits while configuring.
Register read forwards with host context; predicate reports membership in auto-restored host MSR list via linear scan.
Per-VCPU Hyper-V creation prepares synthetic interrupt, timer and flush state on first use and leaves existing state alone; disabled builds succeed idly.
Exception queuing offers vector-plus-code and vector-plus-payload via shared coordinator; helpers expose linear RIP and per-VCPU debug-file creation.

hazards.text: Non-atomic replacement can lose promotion, access-track restore or hardware status; writable-without-dirty and access-dirty-disabled entries always need atomic handling.
Bad reverse-map contents, missing membership or empty-head removal trap or taint once as corruption; oversized counts clamp to the last histogram bucket with one-time warning.

Core-model change after first run or while nested risks stale state, mitigated by equality-only acceptance; excess counts, allocation failures, full buffers, bad emulated padding and copy faults fail cleanly without mutating committed state.

Reporting counter features without auxiliary MSR support risks guest crashes, hidden at startup when inconsistent; descriptor reuse, supervisor-without-save and bad host subleaves warn once with removal and continued enumeration.

One call is bounded by maximum entry count; host probing accepts three bases with indexed functions flagged; synthetic interrupts start versioned, masked and unmapped with fixed timer-expiry type on monotonic absolute timers.

invariants.text: Entry address resolves to owning page and masked values to child pages; zero-frame roots mean absence; position derives from alignment; legacy segment validity equals nonzero handle.
Update path uses software/hardware writability, access-dirty enablement and masked MMIO identity with global caching allowance; clearing lands non-present with accounting only if prior value present.
Reverse tracking resolves via role-selected slot sets plus per-level frame-offset indexing; parent linkage drains one entry at a time to non-present without residency accounting.
Counters combine retained plus live progress when bound, masked to width; mediated sees retained only; general events use include/exclude lists, fixed use bitmap bits; absent filter allows all.
Trigger intersects bitmap with global control then increments allowed counters; unmediated bumps emulated count, mediated wraps with status and PMI; recalc sets software markers on match.

Model changes allowed only before first entry and outside nesting; global control needs version above one; CPUID faulting gates on privilege; guest addresses check reserved bits with LAM-aware CR3 handling.

New CPUID stages without discarding prior state until validation; unsafe contexts accept only equal data; leaves combine desired, kernel, host, passthrough and emulated contributions; vendor/runtime names validate without granting visibility.

Host collection synthesizes hypervisor range and guards extended range with cached maximum; unknown vendors or beyond-max leaves yield absence; out-of-range redirects to maximum basic leaf except two vendors; missing entries zero with topology exceptions.

Leaves cap maxima and replace features from central caps; monitoring/topology zero unless enabled and supported; extended-state masks components with size derivation and supervisor agreement; hardware-gated leaves zero when unsupported; extended/Centaur maxima clamp.

MSR getter gates time-auxiliary, CET and shadow-stack ranges; invariant-TSC suppression depends on VCPU feature cache and VM control; PV and spec-control presence derive from feature masks; family derives from leaf one.

Vectors split into page-fault, five contributory and benign classes; linear RIP is zero when protected else RIP plus truncated CS base; fault cache clears on wildcard or page match; CR4 reserves missing-feature controls; requests record actionable targets; slots have maps when TDP off or shadow root exists.

locks.text: Reverse-map work needs VM memory write hold with preemption disabled, spinning on transient flag with acquire/release pairing; root list uses separate spin; stats walk holds slots mutex then MMU write lock in order.
Each flush queue has a dedicated lock; context pointer publishes with release ordering paired with acquire load for lock-free readers.
PMU event walk holds SRCU read lock for filter safety; host capability queries run pinned with preemption disabled and unpin on all exits.

state_machines.text: Stale subtrees move clean to marked to bounded collected vector to reclaimed with upward clearing; absent/large links prune and duplicates coalesce; roots stay tracked while referenced with validated final detach and deferred destroy.
Clearing chooses fast store versus atomic exchange on presence and concurrent-mutation risk with ordered visibility, both converging on non-present with conditional accounting.
Performance model cycles gated entry, quiescing host bindings with zeroing, neutral-limit publication, vendor realization unless disabled, then default enablement and availability publication.

Exception state moves idle to pending; contributory pairs and page-fault sequences synthesize double fault, double-plus-report requests triple fault, and nested-intercepted reports divert to separate VM-exit record.

Guest CPUID moves stable to staged to resolved with refresh, validation then commit or restore; global caps move cleared to configuring to sealed; enumeration validates, clamps, allocates, expands families, updates count, copies out; XSAVE drops bad subleaves.

structs.text: Reverse head is empty, single pointer, or flagged descriptor chain plus transient locked mark stripped for readers; tail blocks stay full while head absorbs changes, freeing empty head and collapsing.
Normal and nested exception slots share vector, pending/injected flags and code/payload presence plus values; CPUID containers carry count, capacity and contiguous buffer bounded by last maximum.

VCPU Hyper-V context groups synthetic interrupt state, timers with pending mark, VCPU-order index and per-queue sync objects; each timer owns a preformed expiry notice with fixed type, length, identity and cleared timing.

Paging uses 4K terminal depth with fixed density and per-level indexing; reverse heads encode single/chained/empty/locked; Centaur base and basic/structured/vector/extended maxima cap enumeration; rmap stats use eleven buckets and three size labels.
